description: P0-3 parity evidence fixture contract. This schema describes the required fields; tools/parity/evidence_gate.py is the executable gate.

runtime_rules.VERIFIED_PARITY: target_probe.status=OBSERVED, storynpcs_probe.status=OBSERVED, comparison.outcome=MATCH, and target_probe.result equals storynpcs_probe.result; observed results must be meaningful and non-empty
runtime_rules.UNVERIFIED_TARGET_RUNTIME: target_probe.status is UNAVAILABLE, BLOCKED, or NOT_RUN and requires reason plus next_evidence
runtime_rules.certification_eligible: only VERIFIED_PARITY and INTENTIONAL_DEVIATION fixtures with no validation errors
runtime_rules.parity_status: VERIFIED only when certification_eligible is true; otherwise BLOCKED
runtime_rules.failure_context: issue_ids, target_symbol, input, expected_result, actual_result, and evidence_state are required so every failure is actionable
